meta.title: The House · Ie Fushimi
meta.description: A traditional Kyoto house of timber, plaster, well water and a garden, on the way to Fushimi Inari.

label: The House
title: The House
intro: Timber, plaster, well water and a garden. The house was here long before us.

sections.heading: The street
body: The house stands on an old street leading towards Fushimi Inari. Visitors pass on their way to the shrine.
Its lattice front faces the street. From inside, the walk outside becomes sound and shadow.

sections.heading: Timber
body: The timber carries the marks of those who built it. Look along a beam and you can still see where the tools passed.
The walls are plaster and earth. They take the light slowly through the day.

sections.heading: The wells
body: Water rises from wells beneath the house. Tea here begins with it.

sections.heading: The garden
body: Beyond the rooms, a garden changes quietly with the seasons.
Nothing in it stays the same for long. Sit with it a while and you will see.
